verdict.rationale: Cake Equity is a SaaS cap-table platform that holds sensitive company data, so an AI-training opt-out or no-training policy is a fair privacy question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no statement about whether customer data is used to train AI models, and no opt-out control. The read-only MCP access and 2FA are adjacent security and AI features, not a training-data control, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
